title: Australian Jack Cheese Fritters
description: A simple recipe for crispy cheese fritters using Australian jack cheese, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a bowl, combine the Australian jack cheese, Colby cheese, egg, flour, salt, and black pepper.
3. Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
4. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the cheese mixture into the hot oil.
5. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
